scenes.title: Runway · Synthetic example
scenes.text: A client promises Friday. Payment history suggests Tuesday. Plan around the bill that cannot wait.

scenes.title: Confirmed money and expected income stay separate
scenes.text: 800 USDC confirmed. A 1,200 USDC invoice is still expected. Rent and the reserve leave zero available now.

scenes.title: Compare the client's promised date
scenes.text: If the invoice arrives Friday, Monday rent is covered in that scenario. The receipt remains uncertain.

scenes.title: Four past payments change the timing estimate
scenes.text: Delays of 3, 4, 4 and 5 days put the median on Tuesday, after Monday rent. Reducing the purchase by 150 USDC preserves the reserve.

scenes.title: A separate stress test
scenes.text: No payment in the period also requires a 150 USDC reduction. History gives a client-specific reason to consider that risk.

scenes.title: Review before accepting
scenes.text: Only the flexible purchase changes: 250 to 100 USDC. Fixed bills and the 100 USDC reserve remain constraints.

scenes.title: Saved across a reload
scenes.text: The accepted spending plan persists. Saving a plan moves no funds and does not turn an invoice into cash.

scenes.title: Invoice assistant · Free synthetic sample
scenes.text: The parser extracts an invoice draft. Review and edit the fields before saving. No payment was made.

scenes.title: An expectation needs explicit confirmation
scenes.text: This sample is saved only after review. The optional 0.01 USDC paid service requires an isolated wallet and per-purchase approval.

scenes.title: Actual sponsor operations, separate from the sample
scenes.text: Authenticated Tatum Mainnet reads and thirteen synthetic Walrus records have evidence. A fresh process reproduces the remote history calculation.

scenes.title: Corrections supersede old facts
scenes.text: Fresh recall retrieves both versions. A corrected reserve changes the action; a corrected client association prevents a stale timing estimate.

scenes.title: Evidence includes the limits
scenes.text: The synthetic replay includes missed delays and unnecessary reductions. Real user trials and a funded paid-parser purchase remain unverified.
